sudo sh -c 'echo "/tmp/core.%e.%p.%t" > /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern'

Note that `ulimit` only affects the current shell session. For persistence, configure `/etc/security/limits.conf` or a systemd unit's `LimitCORE=`.
